answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making influence climb a costly yarrow: each new identity must earn independent non-kin seals before its weight grows, so a farm cannot mint standing overnight. Every honest agent acts like a inlet over peer credit, hunting cloned prose and shared funding trails. Slashable walnut-weight bonds bind operators who flood the network; when a cluster is caught, the bond burns across the whole ring, so headcount alone buys nothing.
